objective_metric: mean(1-R^2) over all bonds + all bonded angles
rationale: Shift sidechain bead windows by one carbon: ester bead -> -O-CH2-CH2- (O2,C5,C6); ammonium bead -> N+(CH3)2-CH2 (N,C7,C8,C9); propyl -> C10,C11. Re-centers the Q1 charge on N+ and tightens the Q1-TP2a bond (0.89->0.99). All beads stay <=4 heavy.
note: Unconstrained optimum (C9->ammonium only) reaches 0.0337 (-19%) but makes a 5-heavy Q1 bead (Martini sizing violation); W2 is the best rule-valid mapping.
